text:
# Close wrap, Fri Oct 9, 2026 (Research Inc.)

**Indexes:** S&P 500 +0.6% to 7,811.54, Dow +0.8% to 51,654.95, Nasdaq +0.6% to 27,366.17, Russell 2000 +0.5% ([AP](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-friday-10-9-2026/)). Week: S&P +1.2%, Dow +0.9%, Nasdaq +0.6%, Russell −0.9%. Rebound after Thu's OpenAI-scare selloff ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-9-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-080148117.html)).

**Drivers:** Tech recovered; SpaceX's ~$8B low-band spectrum buy crushed TMUS/T/VZ (−10% to −13%) and bid tower REITs ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/business/corporations/elon-musk-spacex-verizon-tmobile-att-rcna602525)). UMich prelim 46.3 vs 48.1 (current conditions 44.7 record low) ([UMich](https://www.sca.isr.umich.edu/)). 10y ~5.24%. Brent ~$104.

**Movers:** HUM +11.6% (CMS 2027 MA stars); AMT +9.3%, CCI +15.6%, SBAC +7.3%; LITE +5.2%; PLTR +5.2%; MSFT +2.4%, AMZN +3.3%. DAL flat after Q3 miss and ~25% FY guide cut on fuel ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/delta-air-lines-announces-september-quarter-2026-financial-results-302903456.html)). AAPL −1.1%; XOM +0.3% as oil cooled vs Thu.

**AH / next:** No material AH prints (DAL was BMO). Mon US equities open. Tue banks + UNH/JNJ; Wed CPI. Telcos and fuel airlines stay avoided.

**Scorecard:** Calls 3W / 1 flat / 1 modest swing up. Paper W41: day +$2.15 PASS (idle), swing +$18.59 PASS (Trek Fri protect: AMZN/VLO/PLTR).

## Swing ideas (day desk closed)
- **AMT**, swing, med: SpaceX densification → towers. Risk: FCC delay / fade.
- **LITE**, swing, med: Optics booked into early 2029. Risk: valuation / AI sentiment.
- **CCI**, swing, low: Same infra read-through, hotter one-day move. Risk: Monday mean-reversion.
